units.source_text: “在这个世界上，要是没有人类，也就不会有京都这个城市。

en.t: In this world, if there were no human beings, there would be no city of Kyoto either.

units.source_text: 这一带就可能成为自然森林，或者草原荒野，说不定还是野鹿和山猪的天地呢。

en.t: This whole area might have become natural forest, or grassland and wilderness, perhaps even a realm for wild deer and mountain boars.

units.source_text: 人类干吗要在这个世界上出现？

en.t: Why did human beings have to appear in this world?
How terrifying that is, human beings...
